node.purpose: Run the bundled local interface, checksum preflight and verification. Cipher uses its separate locked public npm install/build without an npm token.

python.purpose: Run the pinned Lab budget helper and the existing Presence bridge. Complete preflight only checks the version string; it never starts the runtime or collector.

components.name: agent-lab
components.distribution: optional legacy full checkout; canonical textbox mode uses the checked in-repo source subset
components.cleanliness: exact pin with no changes (git status --porcelain must be empty)

components.name: presence-runtime
components.distribution: local-checkout-required; no public download is implied by this pin. Distribution rights and judge access remain open.
components.cleanliness: exact pin; only docs/WORKSTATE.md documentation change by the runtime owner is permitted

offline.description: Repository-only mode. Requires Node only and makes no external calls (no git, no component reads, no provider/collector).

complete.description: Read-only metadata/source-pin/interface/tool validation. Never imports production readers, probes auth/state/provider/collector, clones, downloads, installs or starts the runtime.

notes: Preflight is read-only and side-effect free.
A local pin alone does not grant fresh-clone installation or judge access; remaining prerequisite access is documented in docs/SETUP.md.
Machine configuration (setup.json) stays ignored and is never exposed via the browser.
